name: loro-internal
local_patch: Read-only causal metadata and bounded per-operation JSON inspection for migration. Native local updates are staged under the commit/oplog lock and drained through a serialized FIFO after releasing it, preserving causal publication across observer-triggered, reentrant and concurrent commits. Standalone packaged tests use raw byte counts instead of unpublished dev_utils::ByteSize and omit its optional logging initializer; behavioral assertions are preserved.
